TabContent.dc.html.title: Tab content (one pane, used inside the room)

noteA.text: Two tabs at most. The tab bar only shows what's open: one tab, or two, side by side or one at a time (the layout switch on the right). + opens Text, Draw or Screen, and disappears once two tabs are open: close one with its × first. Nothing replaces a tab by surprise. The Screen tab only exists while someone shares: pressing the share button opens it next to what's there (with two open it takes the underlined tab's place, and that tab comes back when sharing stops). PDFs and pictures come from the drawer: click one, or drag it onto the stage; with two tabs open, only dragging onto "Replace …" works. Drag the thin handles to resize the cameras, the two tabs and the files. Tweaks: student's view, sharing, one tab, folded drawer, Just talk.

noteAuth.text: All sign-in pages share one layout: the form on the left, a short explanation of TeachingTime on the right. On phones the explanation is left out and the form starts at the top, so the keyboard doesn't cover it. Show/hide on password fields, "Forgot your password?" next to the password label, the password rules visible while typing, and a clear pointer for students who land here by mistake. Tweak on Login: show the wrong-password error.

noteClass.text: Classroom. Two columns: Anna, Start lesson and her link on the left; files on the right. The link is shown, not only copied. A drop area for uploads, filters (All, Pictures, PDFs, Audio) instead of three long lists, and storage as a bar. "Remove this classroom" moves here, away from the everyday buttons.

noteDash.text: Dashboard. Classrooms as cards in a grid instead of one long list. A waiting student's card gets the yellow shadow, the circled "Waiting" badge and a brown Start lesson button. "Start a quick call" is the page's main button, top right. Your name in lessons moves to the top bar (click to change), and Remove moves into each card's ⋯ menu so it isn't next to Start lesson. Tweak: quick call in progress.

noteDashNew.text: First visit. Your name first (it's shown on your camera), then the empty grid with the arrow doodle from the roadmap (D5) pointing at "Add a classroom". The arrow is this page's marker stroke, so the name in the top bar has no underline here.

noteDrop.text: Dragging a file from the drawer. The stage shows where it will land. With one tab: "Replace Text" or "Open beside Text". With two: "Replace" one of them. The brown dashed area is the one under the pointer. Clicking the file does the same as "Open beside". With two tabs open, clicking only shows a hint in the drawer (close a tab, or drag onto one).

noteJoin.text: Join. A camera and microphone check before joining, like Google Meet (new: the app doesn't have it yet), one name field and one big button. The underline under "lesson" is the page's marker. Loading and goodbye keep today's wave and tick, and look the same on a phone (one centred card). Tweak: "You left the lesson".

notePhone.text: Phone · student. Two panes don't fit on a phone, so when Laura shows two tabs, Anna gets a two-way switch and opens on the tab Laura is using. Small cameras on top, no drawer.

notePhoneTeacher.text: Phone · teacher. One tab at a time with a two-way switch; each tab has a × when two are open, and + only shows while there's one. Files open in a bottom sheet: tap to show one as the second tab; with two open, the sheet says to close one first. ⋯ opens a second sheet with Mute, "Anna can write and draw" and Just talk, so the bottom bar keeps five big buttons. Tweak: which sheet is open.

noteResize.text:
Resizing. The room follows the window width, not the device.
· 1280 and wider: cameras 240, files open (272).
· 1024–1279: cameras 200, files folded to icons.
· 768–1023: no camera column; small cameras float over the stage's top-right corner.
· Below 768: the phone layout.
Each tab needs at least 320 px. When the stage gets too narrow for two, it switches to one at a time by itself and goes back to side by side when there's room again. Handles: cameras 160–360, files 220–400, the split between tabs; arrow keys work on them too. Sizes are remembered per browser, like today.

noteTeacherPhone.text: Phones. One column. The name chip shrinks to the round initial, "Start a quick call" becomes a full-width button, and the cards stack. In the classroom the drop area is left out (phones can't drag files), and "Upload files" becomes a big full-width button.
